summary: A Sydney city agency with strong testimonials appears to lose appraisals to small errors and a missing appraisal form.

findings.problem: The appraisal path appears to be only a link to /market-appraisal, with no form on the homepage, and Manage My Property appears to link to /rental-appraisal.
findings.cost: Owners who are ready to ask for a price must find another page first.
findings.fix: An appraisal form on the homepage with the right link.

findings.problem: The phone link appears to be written with spaces, and the footer phone link appears to be titled Buy.
findings.cost: Mobile visitors may fail to dial, and the leftover label looks careless.
findings.fix: Clean tel links and correct labels.

findings.problem: A rental listing appears at $70 per week, Trustworth appears in a testimonial, and some listings appear twice.
findings.cost: Visible errors cause buyers and landlords to doubt your attention to detail.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and clean listing feeds.

findings.problem: Most testimonials appear to be first name only without suburb or date, and no principal is named.
findings.cost: Owners want to see who will sell their home and real results.
findings.fix: Named agents, suburbs, dates and review badges.
